REMOVE ALL jewelry: no neck chains, collar, pendant, gems, forehead crystals, armor, metal trim, floral bouquets, busy vine markings, tiny fur-line engravings, detailed feather scales, stars, floating particles or external glow. Do NOT retain decorative complexity from the reference.
ROW1: adorable alert small frost-white FOX juvenile, clearly pointed short muzzle and large blue-tipped ears, four sturdy short legs, ONE rounded fluffy white tail with soft blue tip, calm blue eyes. ROW2: small GRIFFIN cub, rounded warm-brown lion-cub body with four limbs, short simple bronze eagle beak, warm amber eyes, ONE small swept crest, small FOLDED charcoal wings drawn as just2–3 broad feather shapes, plain warm-orange tail tuft. Simple compact fawn, not tall adult deer.
Each animal's body and head are connected. All pets visually infant/juvenile, rounded compact proportions but anatomically coherent, no enormous heads. A tasteful HAND-PAINTED DARK-FANTASY RPG style remains: soft volume, controlled ink-like outer contour, beautiful warm-cool shading, restrained brush texture. NOT flat preschool cartoon, not vector, not noisy photorealistic engraving.
ALL animals face RIGHT in clear side view. EACH ROW columns1–6:1 idle neutral,2 breathing subtle head/ears lift,3 walk first stride,4 walk opposite stride,5 compact forward attack (fox bites, griffin forward claw, deer short antler thrust),6 recoil/hurt. Same anatomy and scale across frames, connected movement sequence.
1536x1024 transparent PNG. Equal ideal cell256x341, but clear empty transparent padding around EVERY complete creature mandatory. Use SMALL sprites approx180px tall rather than filling every cell. Keep paws near cell82% height; keep tails/wings inside cell with generous separation. True transparent background: NO floor, background gradient, shadow, mist, halo or text. Preserve reference row order and action logic; replace complex ornaments with quiet clear natural animal forms. Output only the18-sprite atlas.
